record: H06-H08 rank and component binding supplement

changes.H06: Rank on the original Polars list axis and count non-null values separately; no pandas fallback.
changes.H07: Bind positional and named component slots plus trailing scalar parameters through one declared immutable request mapping; reject conflicts, unknowns, invalid panel types and excess arguments.
changes.H08: Reject non-sequence, wrong-length and non-finite weights before scoring; finite negative and zero weights remain allowed by the existing contract.

verification.rank_cases: none/first/middle/last/all missing, NaN, infinities, ties, singleton and permutation
verification.component_cases: named/positional/gapped/eight-slot forms, directions, weight domain/length and require_full

limitations: FinComponentScore remains experimental; no production admission was changed.
No SQL component-score backend was added.
Tests use the installed Polars team environment, not a newly installed minimum-version environment.
